items.statement: Q2 FY26 net cash from operating activities post working capital change was Rs 190 crore; pre-working capital it was Rs 400 crore. Rs 200 crore tied up in working capital expected to reverse in Q3-Q4. Full-year FY26 operating cash flow expec
items.quote: Company has been maintaining positive cash flows in total in terms of, we had ea rned about this quarter about Rs. 190 crores generated net cash from operating activities post w orking capital change. And in fact, before working capital change, it is about Rs. 400 crores

items.statement: Management plans a preferential issue to fund the GCC and CBG units, with promoters participating.
items.quote: We are planning to go for a preferential round in the times to come for raising money for the GCC unit and the CBG unit. We have our own capital as well, that we are willing to put into the preferential round also.

items.statement: Debtor days increased due to lower certification of work from land acquisition and project clearance delays
items.quote: Yes, MSIDC has been added, but the debtor days increase has been due to lower certification of work. There have been a few projects where certain land acquisition or certain project clearances are pending due to which marginally, it has been lower due to lower certification of our bids.

items.statement: PMC projects provide good cash flow management with monthly payments
items.quote: And it is good for cash flow management as well. It is good for cash flow management as we receive payment on a monthly basis.

items.statement: EBITDA margin is 33% for H1 FY26
items.quote: Thankfully, the EBIT DA, again, looks good, there is a 33% and we want to make sure that we continue to build systems and processes where we can invest more, and, make sure that our foundation is getting stronger and stronger.
